note: Which toolkit capability provides evidence toward which control, and why. A mapping asserts that running the procedure produces evidence RELEVANT to the control -- never that the control is satisfied. Controls almost always require governance, policy, and documentation this toolkit cannot speak to. Each rationale is the argument an auditor would have to defend; disagree with one and change it.

references.rationale: The article covers resilience against attempts to manipulate the system through its inputs; a canary exfiltration battery tests exactly that behaviour, for one class of attack.
Provides a recorded test result for a security property, which is what the subcategory asks be evaluated and documented.
Contributes one verification procedure, with its population and result, to the validation record for the system.
Agreement under paraphrase is a documented reliability measure with a stated method, which is what the subcategory asks for.
Speaks to consistent performance: a system that answers differently depending on phrasing is not performing consistently.
A validation procedure whose population, sample and result are recorded.
Screens whether output is supported by the sources it was given, which is part of validating the model and reading its output in context.
Unsupported claims against provided sources are an accuracy failure of the kind the article addresses.
A validation procedure with a recorded population, sample and exception list.
A hash-chained log of every probe run, with inputs and outputs retained, is the audit history the subcategory describes keeping.
Records events with enough detail to reconstruct what was tested and what came back.
Provides automatic, tamper-evident recording of assurance activity. Note this covers the audit procedures, not the production system's own logging, which is what the article principally concerns.
Re-running a baselined battery and testing the difference for significance is post-deployment monitoring with a defined trigger.
Tracks performance over time rather than at a single point, so a degradation after a model change is detected.
Supports ongoing monitoring of a system already in operation.
Contributes a repeatable technical procedure to post-market monitoring.
Generated workpapers state each procedure's limitations alongside its result, which feeds the documentation users need about where the system should not be trusted.
Measured behaviour and its stated limits are inputs to the information a deployer needs; the toolkit supplies the measurements, not the instructions for use.
Renders the recorded history into a form a reviewer can actually read and challenge.
